correctness.rationale: Let X=G∘K1 for any finite simple labeled G (n>=1). Positive support independence rules out label1, and each degree-one leaf forces exactly (core,leaf)=(3,0),(0,2),(0,3). The core 3-set I must be independent; any (0,2) leaf-core requires a core-3 neighbor, so its core belongs to N_G(I). Thus feasible functions biject with (I,J subset N_G(I)), and weight=3n-|J|, yielding F(z)=z^{3n}B_G(1+z^-1). Extending I to a maximal independent D gives max |N(I)|=n-i(G), so minimum 2n+i(G) and optimizer count highest neighborhood coefficient. Independent enumeration of all 4^8 labelings on P4 agrees with predicted full polynomial {10:5,11:12,12:8}; finite check corroborative only.
